# TriTrader

> TriTrader runs week-long trading competitions of skill. Every entry gets a simulated $80,000 account and trades 86 instruments (FX, indices, commodities, US stocks and crypto) against live prices. Traders are ranked by return %, and fixed prizes, set in advance and paid by TriTrader, go to the top-ranked traders. No real trades are placed.

## Beta Championship
- Dates: Monday 23 November 2026 00:01 to Sunday 29 November 2026 23:59, UK time.
- Entry fee: £100 per entry.
- Starting balance: $80,000 simulated, per entry.
- Leverage: chosen at entry from 1:1, 1:10, 1:30, 1:50, 1:100 (default), 1:200 or 1:500; fixed for that entry.
- Re-entry: a blown account can re-enter up to twice (£100 each) until Thursday 17:00 UK. Only the trader's best entry is ranked.
- Prizes: £3,500 across 15 awards, paid in full whatever the number of entries and never split.
  - Place prizes (£2,950): 1st £1,000, 2nd £500, 3rd £300, 4th £200, 5th £200, 6th to 10th £150 each.
  - Bonus prizes (£550): Sharpest Trader £150, Best Comeback £150, Steady Hand £100, Best Risk Control £100, Most Active £50.
- Ties: the trader who reached the tied return first ranks higher.

## Rules in brief
- All trading is simulated. Simulated balances have no cash value. The most a trader can lose is the entry fees they pay.
- Orders: market, limit, stop and stop-limit, with take-profit, stop-loss, trailing stops and hedging. Costs are spread only.
- Margin call at 100% margin level; automatic stop-out at 50%.
- Eligibility: 18+, identity-verified, one person one account, any country except those under UK sanctions.
- Fair play: automated trading is banned; every order waits a random 100–300 ms and fills on the next live price; every trade is replayable; prize winners are reviewed before payout.
- Public leaderboard refreshes every 30 seconds; open positions are shown 15 minutes delayed, under handles only.
- Prizes are paid by bank transfer to an account in the winner's verified name.
- Nothing on TriTrader is investment advice.

## Instruments (86)
- FX (20): majors, crosses and exotics.
- Indices (8): US 500, US Tech 100, US 30, Germany 40, UK 100, Japan 225, Hong Kong 50, Korea 200.
- Commodities (8): gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper, WTI crude, Brent crude, natural gas.
- US stocks (25), regular session only.
- Crypto (25), 24/7.

## Current status
- Pre-launch. The waitlist is open; joining is free, needs only an email, and carries no obligation to pay.
